infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Interi Remix uses the camera to capture photos inside the app before you publish them.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Interi Remix accesses your photo library so you can move media between the app and your library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Interi Remix saves media you export from the app into your photo library.
